address: 69 Soi Prasat Suk, Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok, 10120, Thailand
bio: Popular among both Thai and foreign foodies and housed in a Bauhaus-style villa surrounded by sculpture-filled gardens, Clara is an elegant Italian fine-dining restaurant from a seasoned Italian chef and his wife. The villa’s two-floor interior has a warm minimalist vibe. The set menu balances flavours and complex textures which are matched by the fine service. Pair with wine for a complete experience....
